error_cases.metrics_impact: Precision suppressed to 27.81%, resulting in the lowest per-video F1 score (42.53%) despite 90.38% recall.

error_cases.metrics_impact: Precision drops to 30.00% despite achieving 100.00% recall (9/9 TP).

error_cases.metrics_impact: Precision capped at 45.49% despite capturing 116/121 true positive boundaries (95.87% recall).

error_cases.description: Video cd6_chuyen2 produced the lowest recall among all validation videos at 75.00% (13 missed boundaries out of 52 GT).
error_cases.metrics_impact: Limits overall recall ceiling on complex, multi-stage sewing cycles.

factual_observations: EfficientGEBD achieves 57.60% Macro F1 at 0.5s tolerance, outperforming DiffGEBD (40.77%) and DDM-Net (24.80%) on the same Chuyen 1 benchmark.
The model exhibits exceptionally high recall at 88.09% (392/445 true boundaries detected within 0.5s), scaling to 96.85% at 1.0s tolerance.
The dominant failure mode is over-segmentation and false-positive clustering: 916 total predictions were generated for 445 ground-truth boundaries (2.06x over-generation).
Across all 9 validation videos, recall ranges between 75.00% and 100.00%, while precision remains constrained between 27.81% and 64.71%.
